paragraphs.text:
You follow a gully up into oak-covered slopes. You notice an 
odd hircine odor. When you look up, you see that both rims 
are occupied.

Make a Sanity roll: if you fail it, lose 1D6 Sanity. If you suffer temporary 
or indefinite insanity, go to 310. If you remain in control, go to 309.
